description: Reflection against 192.0.2.50: 60 NTP servers (monlist responses from port 123) and 40 SSDP hosts (from port 1900) send it 3000 datagrams in 3s. The reflector-port rule fires at the 2001st; 3000 packets stay below the udp_flood rules. An NTP client syncing with four servers first does not fire.
